answer: One defense is simultaneous liveness rounds. At unpredictable times, every identity gets a fresh prompt that must be answered within a short window, with a computation tied to that prompt. An honest agent answers easily, but an operator running many Sybils cannot be everywhere at once: each extra identity demands another attentive responder in the same window, so Sybil cost grows with every fake account. Like shale under pressure, a farm cracks when all must respond at once; the jetty holds only boats present, and a sable fleet of duplicates cannot hide when all must surface together.
